meta.title: LeyMish AI Shopping Readiness: a sample store with real gaps
meta.description: A throwaway WooCommerce store in your browser, seeded with six products that have the problems the audit actually finds: no GTIN, no brand, missing alt text, a thin description. Press Run the audit and see a score that isn't 100.
meta.author: leymish

steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped' => true)); update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no'); $rows = array(array('Washed linen apron', '29', 'Washed linen apron, one size, navy. Two front pockets.'), array('Stoneware mug', '18', 'Hand-thrown stoneware mug, 300 ml, speckled glaze.'), array('Beeswax candle', '24', 'Pure beeswax candle in a reusable tin, 40 hours.'), array('Cotton tea towel', '12', 'Waffle-weave cotton tea towel, 50 x 70 cm.'), array('Olive wood board', '45', 'Olive wood serving board, 30 cm, oiled finish.'), array('Ceramic jug', '38', 'Small jug.')); foreach ($rows as $r) { $p = new WC_Product_Simple(); $p->set_name($r[0]); $p->set_regular_price($r[1]); $p->set_description($r[2]); $p->set_status('publish'); $p->save(); }
